method.read_mechanism: PowerShell Get-Content / ConvertFrom-Json with selected fields, followed by functions JavaScript declaration comparisons
method.manual_count_rule: Count unique cases.case_id only where cases.actual_image_opened is exactly true; retain declared counts for reconciliation rather than inferring viewing from them.
method.reference_count_rule: Count references.actual_image_opened exactly true separately by record, unique reference ID and unique declared SHA. Repeated opens remain separate records.
method.optional_path_rule: Reference copies with different local paths can retain the same logical owner identity; this audit compares their declared ID and SHA without reading or rehashing the images.
method.case_sha_record_format: Each per-case sha256 value is the input owner declaration. matched_artifact_fields names the matching report declaration field for each artifact. Mismatches would preserve both values in metadata_issues; no file bytes are read for these comparisons.
